business_problem: Fragmented data across multiple business units VinBigData needed to support its customers, including parent company Vingroup, in centralizing and integrating often fragmented data and AI solutions to drive efficiencies and stimulate innovation.
solution_summary: Fragmented data across multiple business units VinBigData needed to support its customers, including parent company Vingroup, in centralizing and integrating often fragmented data and AI solutions to drive efficiencies and stimulate innovation. VinBigData first built its applications on MongoDB for its database features and in 2022 the company migrated to on Amazon Web Services (AWS), as VinBigData’s application services’ architecture was also built on AWS. The lack of a centralized data management system made it challenging for VinBigData’s customers to maintain data accuracy, while monitoring and controlling operations effectively. “Fragmented data across multiple business units stifled our customers’ ability to innovate, expand, and make data-driven decisions. We built a centralized data management solution on MongoDB to provide our customers with a comprehensive, unified, and real-time view of their operations,” said Nguyen.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational, document, and context data behind VinBigData's analytics and data-platform workloads.

data_flow: Business documents, tickets, records, and other operational content stay in MongoDB Atlas Vector Search and MongoDB Atlas, where search indexes or vector embeddings are built and then queried in real time to supply grounded results to applications, assistants, or discovery features. Upstream and downstream integrations include AWS, support chat, APIs.

Fragmented data across multiple business units VinBigData needed to support its customers, including parent company Vingroup, in centralizing and integrating often fragmented data and AI solutions to drive efficiencies and stimulate innovation.

VinBigData first built its applications on MongoDB for its database features and in 2022 the company migrated to on Amazon Web Services (AWS), as VinBigData’s application services’ architecture was also built on AWS. With MongoDB Atlas, VinBigData’s customers can easily integrate and analyze petabytes of historical and real-time data from their operations. This helps companies like VinFast gain insights to improve decision-making and accelerate its global electric vehicle ambitions with improved product and service quality, while enhancing user experiences.
